summary: List Specification Sections Revisions for a Project
description: This endpoint returns a paginated list of Specification Sections Revisions for a Project.

parameters.name: specification_area_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the specification area.

schema.description: A version of a Specification Section. Each time a Specification Section is revised, the newly uploaded version is a new revision of that section.

description.description: The description of this revision's SpecificationSection

division.description: Represents a construction division, which is used to group specification sections. Each SpecificationSectionDivision can contain many SpecificationSections.

issued_date.description: The date when the SpecificationRevision was issued by the architect

number.description: The number of this revision's SpecificationSection

received_date.description: The date when the SpecificationRevision was received by the project

revision.description: The revision number of the SpecificationSectionRevision

url.description: Address of SpecificationRevision PDF. This can be blank if the Specification Section was created manually without an upload, and no revisions have been uploaded yet.

403.description: User does not have right permissions
